name: Processor D
design_rationale: Selected after a three-candidate official QFF 2026 benchmark. The four-qubit K4 core directly connects all six pairwise asset interactions in the dense PS-O2 QUBO and the six-qubit graph compiles the p=1 circuit with zero measured routing CX overhead and zero SWAPs in the candidate sweep. A two-edge tail provides a distance-3 farthest pair for the required Bell experiment without the additional coupler used by the bridge-leaf alternative. The single-seed Bell-fidelity lead was small and is not claimed to be statistically significant.
